solutions.title: Bounded BFS
solutions.strategy: Run ordinary BFS from the origin inside a conservative box around the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: The searched square grows with r = max(|x|, |y|).

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue and visited set can contain every bounded square.

solutions.title: Symmetric BFS
solutions.strategy: Reflect the target into the first quadrant and prune states outside the small useful negative border.

timeComplexity.explanation: After reflection, BFS stays inside the target rectangle plus a constant negative/positive margin.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Visited states stay within the pruned rectangle around the reflected target.
